messages.subject: Project Lumen - Mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Good to speak yesterday. Crestview would like to start diligence on Luminos AI, so enclosing our standard mutual NDA for the proposed Series B. It runs for a two-year term and carries a residual-knowledge carve-out at clause 6, which I believe matches how your side usually likes these.

Grateful for any comments, otherwise happy to get it signed this week.

Best,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Lumen - Mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. The mutual form is fine and the two-year term works. The residual-knowledge carve-out at clause 6 is important to our client - they speak to a number of investors and cannot have heads of knowledge fenced off - so that stays in as drafted. On that basis treat the NDA as agreed; no further mark-up from us.

Kind regards,
Rachel

Rachel Hargrove | Partner | Hargrove & Associates LLP
